title: feat(console): the first-run checklist shows the built-in AI provider and folds done rows; every not-found page has a way back
body:
Part of #32021
Fixes #32157
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：首次使用清单新增一行「设置内置 AI」，读取服务端实际在用的 AI 服务商（`GET /api/settings/ai` 的 `live.provider`）；清单里已完成的项默认折叠，只留待办；四种「找不到」页面（对象、网址、记录、应用）共用一个组件，每种都有返回路径（返回列表 / 返回首页）。
- 为什么改：新装私有部署的管理员最先想用内置 AI，清单里却没有这一步；清单占满手机首屏且已完成项占位置；有两种「找不到」页面是死胡同。
- 风险与回滚：只动控制台 UI 与语言包（只增键）；服务端未声明 `live` 时不画 AI 这一行，旧服务端行为不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/firstRunChecklistLogic.ts`（`aiProviderState`：只读 `live`，不读 `values`）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/components/NotFoundState.tsx`（`BackToHomeButton` 的首页解析）、`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/FirstRunChecklist.tsx`（折叠控件）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/components/__tests__/NotFoundState.test.tsx`，预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**#32021 item 4: the built-in AI on the first-run checklist.** A new row, "Set up the built-in AI", is read from `live.provider` of `GET /api/settings/ai`, which landed in #32057. It never reads `values.provider`, because that only says what was saved, and the runtime can detect a provider from its boot environment while nothing is saved. A provider in use makes the row done. The row names the provider by its option label and says where it came from: "set in Setup", or "detected from the server environment". With `source: 'none'` the row is not done and links to Setup → AI & Embedder. A server that does not state the provider gets no row, because unknown is not unset. Only a session that may write `ai` reads it. The external assistant row keeps the wording from PR #32050, and its Home claim is unaffected. Item 4 was the last open item on #32021: once this merges, the card can close.

The values arrive once the AI runtime fills `registerLiveStatus('ai')`. That runtime is cloud service-ai, and the carry is recorded on #32052. On this repository alone `live` is absent, so the row stays out, as designed.

**#32157: Home crowding.** Rows that are done are folded away. The list draws the rows still to do. One control under them ("Show completed (N)" / "Hide completed", with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`) unfolds the done rows in their place. Every visit starts folded. The progress count is unchanged.

**#32157: not-found states.** Unknown object, unmatched URL, unknown record and unknown app now draw through one `NotFoundState`. Each keeps its own title and cause sentence and offers its own way back first, then "Back to home":
- unknown object: "Back to home" only (before: no way out);
- unmatched URL: "Go back" and "Back to home";
- unknown record: "Back to OBJECT-LIST", a link to the object's list, then "Back to home" (before: no way out);
- unknown app: "Retry" and "Back to home".

The app-access-denied screen uses the same button. `BackToHomeButton` resolves Home with `useHomePath()`'s policy (`resolveDeclaredHomePath`, else the launcher) against `@object-ui/react`'s metadata context. Screens that already hold `useHomePath()` pass it as `to`, as every AppContent screen does. It does not import `useHomePath` itself, because that module loads the console metadata provider and the metadata client factory into every view that draws a not-found state. That import broke 18 RecordDetailView harnesses at collection.

New `@object-ui/i18n` keys in all 11 packs (zh-Hant regenerated with `gen:zh-hant`): `console.firstRunChecklist.aiProvider.{title,todo,doneSettings,doneEnvironment,action}`, `console.firstRunChecklist.{showDone,hideDone}`, `empty.backToList`. No key is removed or renamed.

## Tests

Final head `4b7db52a3`:
- Consumer sweep: every test file in `packages/app-shell/src` and `apps/console/src` that reaches `RecordDetailView`, `objectViewChrome`, `ObjectView`, `NotFoundState` or `AppContent`, plus the checklist and i18n parity tests. 312 files, 2813 tests passed, in 4 chunks under the shared lock.
- Type-checks: `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console`, `@object-ui/i18n` `type-check` all exit 0.

<details><summary>Ablations (each via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs on the committed tree, restored blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- A1, environment-detected provider treated as not in use: `FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx` 1 failed / 35 passed ("detected from the boot environment").
- A2, done rows not folded: `FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx` 2 failed / 34 passed (both fold pins).
- A3, unknown-object state without its Home button: `NotFoundState.test.tsx` 3 failed / 0 passed.
- A4, record not-found without the list link: `RecordDetailView.recordReadFailure-11902.test.tsx` 2 failed / 9 passed (control on the same head: 11/11 passed).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The unknown-object title stays "Object Not Found" (title case) beside "Page not found" / "Record not found". Changing an `en` value reds `check:i18n-drift` for all ten follower packs, and the claim allows adding keys only. Noted, not changed.
- The premise reading (the checklist takes about 60% of a 1440×900 first screen, and all of a 390 px one) was not re-measured in a browser in this run. NOT MEASURED: no backend stack was built, and the shared lock was contended. On `origin/main` the code draws every row, done or not, which is the mechanism #32157 names.
- Existing harnesses touched: `AppContent.noAppComponentRoutes` now loads `@objectstack/lint` at module top, as `check:test-source-alias` asks of an edited file. `recordReadFailure-11902` mounts the record page on the console's record route, so the list link has its app segment.

## Verification

Gates derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `4b7db52a3`, and run locally. Also run: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` and `check:i18n-dead-keys` (all exit 0), `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (5062 passed, 2 skipped), and `gen:zh-hant` reports zh-Hant already current. Dogfood battery: n/a (no `!` in the title, no narrowing arm).
